Use case: precise asset edit. Edit ONLY the shoe construction in the referenced production PNG. It incorrectly shows closed heel-back pumps; make a genuine BACKLESS MULE pair instead.
Preserve the 1024x1536 transparent canvas, exact bottom-canvas location, left/right size, outward toe directions, ivory matte hand-painted texture, sewn almond toes, and low block heels.
CRITICAL construction change: REMOVE the entire tall rear quarters and closed heel cups from both shoes. Each shoe must have a closed toe and a relatively low vamp ending over the mid-foot, with a fully OPEN heel/back. Shorten the leather side walls so they end near the mid-foot, never wrapping around the heel. The visible opening should be broad, horizontal-ish and low, not a tall teardrop instep surrounded by a pump back. Keep the low block heel sole below, but NO heel straps or heel-counter upper. Transparent empty back, no foot, skin or sock. This should be unmistakably a slip-on mule, not a pump.
Do not change viewpoint, palette, material, pair spacing, or canvas framing. No background, halo, shadows outside shoe, detached fragments or text.

qualityControl.source: All 63 catalogue paintings audited as RGBA8 1024x1536 with transparent corners and visible margins; existing paintings preserved.
qualityControl.fit: Shared body anchors unchanged. Peacoat sleeves and torso have independent continuous mesh fit; blazer cuffs narrowed. Fitted coats tuck high waist sides without exposing the base waist. New full-length trousers hide covered calves. Backless mule revision clears the insole area occupied by the foot and samples the chosen skin bucket.
qualityControl.visual: Six specialist mixed outfits checked in full, torso and feet framing across light, medium and deep skin buckets. Foot-detail framing reduced to keep toe tips inside the preview.
qualityControl.inGame: Four-piece catalogue outfit retained across search and category changes. Owned and unowned catalogue cards both preview-only. Optional apron and neck removal are temporary. Original worn outfit remains restorable.

limitations: 389 entries are colourways and family adaptations, not 389 bespoke illustrations. Other specialist cuts still share existing family art; this batch only differentiates the 12 listed cuts.
The rejected mule v1 candidate is preserved for provenance but never used by the runtime.
Painted clothing is registered to the current front-view stationary player body. This work does not add walk-cycle garment directions.
